text: First-tier treatments include head elevation, neuromuscular paralysis, analgesia, continued sedation, normocapnia and normothermia. Second-tier treatments include deepening of sedation, cerebrospinal fluid drainage, moderate hypocapnia, and administration of hyperosmolar molecules. Therapy intensity level (TIL basic) was recorded for each patient to quantify the intensity of ICP-directed treatment.
